address: Novi Beograd Blok 44, Gandijeva BB, Beograd , Serbia, Belgrade, 11070, Serbia
bio: Picture a floating house, idyllically located on the River Sava and framed by lush green banks, which are perfect for a stroll before your meal. The roomy interior features a refined, yet snug inviting vibe, setting the scene for a memorable dining experience. The kitchen rises to the occasion with an extensive lineup of traditional dishes that showcase the quality of the meat, complemented by excellent seafood and freshwater fish options....
